findings.evidence: The skill establishes target/toolchain/artifact/launch configuration, separates bytecode edges from runtime and semantic dependencies, uses -filter:none and a known-edge control, and treats missing/stale artifacts as incomplete evidence.
findings.consequence: No source-only or filtered absence claim is authorized. The explicit filter and control matter even when published tool documentation differs from the actual build.

findings.evidence: The worked example bases valuation placement on responsibility/history; the deletion explicitly assumes controlled, migrated consumers. It covers binary/source callers, an interface alternative, unchanged accepted stock data dependencies and optional JPMS enforcement.
findings.consequence: The acyclic after-graph is not treated as proof of compatibility. Isolated actual binary execution confirmed the existing caveat.

findings.evidence: Ca/Ce counting convention and zero denominator are explicit; history and metric thresholds are not verdicts. Shared final references, legitimate data/mode parameters, generated code, test scope and package/protected access have contextual exceptions.
findings.consequence: Avoids superficial package churn and unsafe visibility expansion without imposing a full metric program.

findings.evidence: Oracle JDK25 jdeps man page describes same-archive filtering for -verbose:class. Temurin 25.0.3+9 execution and matching JdepsTask source show filterSamePackage=true, filterSameArchive=false. The initial harness expectation based on that manual was refuted, retained and corrected.
findings.consequence: Do not copy the manual's default-filter sentence as a guaranteed behavior. The skill already instructs testing a known edge and links implementation sources.
findings.action: No catalog defect. No upstream issue or external message was submitted.
